Load perturbation signatures

Source: R/loadSignatures.R
loadSignatures.Rd

Reads the perturbation signatures (per-gene logistic regression coefficients) for human or mouse. The TSV file is downloaded from https://zenodo.org/records/23986547/ on the first call and read from the cache afterwards.

Usage

loadSignatures(
  species = c("hsa", "mmu"),
  geneId = c("symbol", "entrez"),
  cacheDir = tools::R_user_dir("pertsig", which = "cache"),
  force = FALSE
)

Arguments

species

Species code: "hsa" (human) or "mmu" (mouse).

geneId

Gene identifiers to use as row names: "symbol" or "entrez". If an identifier occurs more than once, only its first row is kept.

cacheDir

Directory where downloaded files are cached.

force

If TRUE, download the file again even if it is cached.

Value

A numeric matrix of signature weights with genes in rows and signatures in columns. Signatures that merge several perturbations are named after the first one ("IFNG + STAT1" becomes "IFNG").

Examples

# \donttest{
signatures <- loadSignatures("mmu", geneId = "entrez")
signatures[1:3, 1:2]
#>        17_ESTRADIOL 2_3_7_8_TETRACHLORODIBENZO_P_DIOXIN
#> 18770     0.2714234                          -1.6146960
#> 12038    -0.3557221                          -0.9174224
#> 230603   -0.2913645                          -1.0929476
# }
